newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil prices firmer but rise dulls demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil prices firmer but rise dulls demand.

text.p: NWE spot gas oil prices advanced on Tuesday led higher by stronger benchmark gas oil futures, but trade was thin with the gains dulling barge buying interest and good supplies weighing on cargo premiums, traders said.

Good Russian avails pegged back 0.2 sulphur cargo premiums cargo premiums to value around IPE July screen flat for prompt delivery 25kt parcels. The 10kt stems were on offer around July IPE +$1 cif Hamburg and fob cargoes talked around MOM -$7.50/-$8.

Prompt delivery diesel cargoes talked July IPE +$5/+$6 a tonne cif NWE while early July cargoes valued around July IPE +$6 a tonne cif NWE. Quality Algerian material was also reported available at around July IPE +$7.00/+$7.50 a tonne cif NWE.
Traders said that good supplies of most grades were keeping buyers relaxed with light buying seen for 0.2 sulphur oil in to northern Germany.

Similarly the sharp jump in screen prices dulled business on the key ARA barge market. Prompt lifting barges fob AR valued around July IPE even though Antwerp supplies were seen available at around 75 cents below this level.
